files.README.md:
Carrowbank Estate Office - insurance folder

The renewal file holds one survey report for each part of the estate. Reports
are written by the surveyor and filed here as they arrive.
files.surveys/boiler-report.txt:
Boiler house survey - estate yard
Flue liner scored near the top outlet.
Pressure vessel certificate expires 2026-04-30.
Action: book the annual check.
files.surveys/roof-report.txt:
Roof survey - main barn
Twelve slates slipped on the north pitch.
Ridges and valleys sound.
Action: scaffold for two days in March.
files.surveys/wiring-report.txt:
Wiring survey - cottages and office
Thermal damage at the busbar in the consumer unit.
Two spur sockets to be removed.
Action: isolate and rewire the office ring.

turns.prompt: The broker handling the Carrowbank Estate Office renewal wants the three survey reports in this folder gathered into one zip archive, so the submission goes over as a single attachment. Build that archive in this folder and confirm it holds all three reports. Let me know when the folder is ready.
